prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. One elegant wide-brim straw hat viewed at an angle, one side brim lifted, a flowing ribbon bow and two sparse curved weave hints only.
Pure outline drawing, empty white interiors, no gray fill or cast shadow. Only requested components. Absolutely no repeated stitch dashes, hatch marks, weaving texture or decorative motifs. All objects fully visible and contained within generous 10 percent margins.
